items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Who played drums in that band, in the Bennie Moten band? Mac Washington.

ctx.x: Who played drums in that band, in the Bennie Moten band?

Mac Washington. Looked somewhat like Jimmie Crawford but very beautiful. What they used to call, they call bombs now, stumbles - he made stumbles. He made that connection from the interlude to the... - nobody could drop in the bucket like him. A lot of times they used to ask me to do recordings and I'd say, "Send for Crawford. I'm not going to play these 4 bars. I don't know how to play them yet. Send for Crawford to play these 4 bars and I'll finish the date... Because he knew how to play dum - de dum - de dum -…
